name: Anatomy Learning Labs: Skeletal Lab
summary:
Step into the Skeletal Lab of the Anatomy Learning Labs series, where the framework of the human body comes to life in stunning 3D. Featuring anatomically accurate models developed by medical professionals and learning activities designed by professors, the Skeletal Lab teaches elementary, middle, and high school learners how bones support movement, protect vital organs, and work together as a complete system.
